reason: Mechanism verified at HEAD 2e23b46: the linkname-injected crypto hooks (hash and cipher orchestrion.yml) call vulnerability.Report from woven stdlib bodies whose init graph never imports vulnerability/spans/tracer. With config.Enabled defaulting to true, an application package that hashes with sha1/md5 (or uses des/rc4) during its own init lands in the window between internal/config init and tracer/spans init; tracer.StartSpan's nil-global-tracer type assertion (dd-trace-go ddtrace/internal/globaltracer.go:43) panics with no recover and the process dies before main. Independently reproduced with my own woven reproducer (sha1.New() in an init() of a regexp-importing package: EXIT=2, panic in fp.init.0) under default config on go1.26.6; DD_IAST_ENABLED=false exits 0; a control layout where the hashing package initializes before internal/config does not crash, confirming the claimed window boundaries. Not documented in README or phase-1 design intent; breaks product rule #1. Severity stays Critical: crash reachable from ordinary customer code (or third-party dependencies) under default configuration.
